previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for scheduled flexible bronchoscopy with balloon dilation and bronchial wash due to recurrent tracheal stenosis related to relapsing polychondritis. The procedure was performed without complications, and he remained stable throughout the admission with no respiratory distress or pain. Laboratory results showed leukocytosis, attributed to underlying inflammatory disease rather than infection. He was discharged home with a five-day course of high-dose prednisone, instructions to resume his baseline medications, and follow-up planned with interventional pulmonology in four weeks for review of biopsy and culture results. His breathing improved, and oxygen was successfully weaned prior to discharge.
